title: Minimal BLAS/TLAS build with sync and non-null TLAS logging
rationale: Establish a working acceleration structure foundation with a single proxy (plane/disc), synchronized for same-frame sampling.

edits.action: Create a small static vertex buffer (plane or ring) with USAGE ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_KHR | SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT; build BLAS; build TLAS with a single instance; add Synchronization2 barrier from AS build to FRAGMENT_SHADER read; print TLAS handle and device address; assert non-null.

instrumentation: Print: [RT] BLAS built, TLAS handle, TLAS device address
If null, print error and gate off RT path
acceptance: No validation errors during AS build
TLAS handle is non-null and device address is logged
